subject: Mobile Development
title: How App Updates Work
description: A short lesson to help you apply How App Updates Work.

hook.text: You open the app store and see 23 updates waiting. What actually happens when you tap update?

buildup.text: The store downloads a new binary, verifies its signature, and replaces the old version.

discovery.text: Apps must migrate their local databases when the data structure changes between versions.

twist.text: A botched migration can corrupt user data. Some bugs only appear on update, not fresh install.

climax.text: Smooth updates are critical — one bad release can trigger a wave of one-star reviews.

punchline.text: Updates must keep old data while running new code.

quiz.question: What must apps do when their data structure changes in an update?
